title: Energy density-driven structural tuning of Al2O3/AgO films for enhanced toxic gas detection
content:
RSC Adv., 2026, 16,24306-24324

Doaa Yaseen Doohee, Abas Azarian, Mohammad Reza Mozaffari
This study examines how laser energy density during pulsed laser deposition (PLD) affects the structural, optical, electrical, and gas-sensing properties of Al2O3/AgO thin films.
